title: Bronchopulmonary Dysplasia with Pulmonary Hypertension Associates with Loss of Semaphorin Signaling and Functional Decrease in FOXF1 Expression.
authors: Shirazi, Shawyon P; Negretti, Nicholas M; Jetter, Christopher S; Sharkey, Alexandria L; Garg, Shriya; Kapp, Meghan E; Wilkins, Devan; Fortier, Gabrielle; Mallapragada, Saahithi; Banovich, Nicholas E; Wright, Christopher V E; Frank, David B; Kropski, Jonathan A; Sucre, Jennifer M S
journal: bioRxiv : the preprint server for biology
one_liner_zh: 该文通过单细胞RNA测序研究早产儿支气管肺发育不良中FOXF1表达下降与信号通路变化，属于纯转录组表达分析，未涉及蛋白质-DNA互作建模或AI/物理模拟方法，与本课题关联微弱。
abstract: Lung injury in preterm infants leads to structural and functional respiratory deficits, with a risk for bronchopulmonary dysplasia (BPD) that in its most severe form is accompanied by pulmonary hypertension (PH). To examine cellular and molecular dynamics driving evolving BPD in humans, we performed single-cell RNA sequencing of preterm infant lungs in early stages of BPD and BPD+PH compared to term infants. Analysis of the endothelium revealed a unique aberrant capillary cell-state primarily in BPD+PH marked by ANKRD1 expression. Predictive signaling analysis identified deficits in the semaphorin guidance-cue signaling pathway and decreased expression of pro-angiogenic transcription factor FOXF1 within the alveolar parenchyma in neonatal lung samples with BPD/BPD+PH. Loss of semaphorin signaling was replicated in a murine BPD model and in humans with alveolar capillary dysplasia (ACDMPV), suggesting a mechanistic link between the developmental programs underlying BPD and ACDMPV and a critical role for semaphorin signaling in normal lung development.
abstract_zh: 早产儿肺损伤导致结构和功能性呼吸缺陷，并有发生支气管肺发育不良（bronchopulmonary dysplasia, BPD）的风险，其最严重形式伴有肺动脉高压（pulmonary hypertension, PH）。为了探究驱动人类BPD进展的细胞和分子动态，我们对早产儿在BPD早期阶段及BPD+PH状态下的肺部进行了单细胞RNA测序，并与足月儿进行比较。对内皮细胞的分析揭示了一种独特的异常毛细血管细胞状态，主要存在于BPD+PH中，以ANKRD1表达为标志。预测性信号分析识别出在BPD/BPD+PH新生儿肺样本的肺泡实质中，semaphorin导向线索信号通路存在缺陷，且促血管生成转录因子FOXF1表达降低。semaphorin信号缺失在小鼠BPD模型及人类肺泡毛细血管发育不良（ACDMPV）中得以重现，提示BPD与ACDMPV背后的发育程序之间存在机制性联系，并表明semaphorin信号在正常肺发育中发挥关键作用。
